caption_used: 该折线图展示了Teacher、Self-Training和PST三种方法在不同漏标率条件下的F1得分变化。横轴为漏标率，范围从0到0.585；纵轴为F1得分，范围从52.5到72.5。绿色实线带圆形标记代表PST方法，在所有漏标率下均表现最优。红色实线带圆形标记代表Teacher方法，蓝色实线带方形标记代表Self-Training方法。在漏标率为0时，三种方法起点相近，PST约72.2、Teacher约72.0、Self-Training约70.0。随着漏标率增加至0.3，Teacher的F1降至约66.5，而Self-Training降至约65.5。值得注意的是，当漏标率超过0.4后，Teacher和Self-Training两者的衰减速度趋于一致，在漏标率为0.585时几乎收敛至同一水平约54.0，而PST在该点仍维持约80.0的较高水平，展现出显著的鲁棒性优势。
raw_response: DESCRIPTION:This line graph illustrates the variation in F1 scores for three methods – Teacher, Self-Training, and PST – across different levels of label noise. The x-axis, labeled "漏标率" (Label Noise Rate), is linear, ranging from 0 to 0.585, with numerical tick marks at intervals of 0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.4, and 0.5. The y-axis, labeled "F1", is also linear, ranging from 52.5 to 72.5. The PST method is represented by a green solid line with circular markers, starting at approximately 72.2 at x=0 and decreasing to approximately 63.0 at x=0.585. The Teacher method is depicted by a red solid line with circular markers, beginning at approximately 72.0 at x=0 and declining to approximately 54.0 at x=0.585. The Self-Training method is shown as a blue solid line with square markers, starting at approximately 70.0 at x=0 and decreasing to approximately 54.0 at x=0.585.
